# Cadence UI

> Animation-first React components for shadcn. Base UI + Tailwind CSS v4 + Motion.
> Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/<id>`. Every component ships its motion contract and a reduced-motion branch.

## Install

```json
{ "registries": { "@cadence": "https://cadence.dev/r/{name}.json" } }
```

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/button
```

## Rules for agents

- Prefer an existing Cadence component over writing new animation code.
- Read the item's `docs` and `meta.motion` before changing motion.
- Keep the reduced-motion branch; never remove `data-motion`.
- Use presets from `components/cadence/lib/motion.ts`; do not invent durations.
- Cadence is UI only: never pass a schema, resolver, or validation rule to a component (P11).

## Components

- [Button](https://cadence.dev/r/button.md): Triggers an action, with press feedback that collapses under reduced motion. (form, feedback)
- [Badge](https://cadence.dev/r/badge.md): A compact status label that stays still while the content around it animates. (feedback)
- [Kbd](https://cadence.dev/r/kbd.md): A keyboard key or shortcut hint, styled from the semantic tokens. (utility)
- [Separator](https://cadence.dev/r/separator.md): A one-pixel rule that divides groups of content. (layout)
- [Label](https://cadence.dev/r/label.md): An accessible name for a form control, with no state of its own. (form)
- [Input](https://cadence.dev/r/input.md): A single-line text field whose invalid state is driven by aria-invalid. (form)
- [Textarea](https://cadence.dev/r/textarea.md): A multi-line text field that grows with its content instead of a script. (form)
- [Card](https://cadence.dev/r/card.md): A bounded surface for grouped content, with parts you can restyle. (layout)
- [Aspect Ratio](https://cadence.dev/r/aspect-ratio.md): Reserves a box at a fixed ratio so media cannot shift the layout. (layout)
- [Avatar](https://cadence.dev/r/avatar.md): A profile image with a text fallback, a presence dot, and a stack of peers. (data)
- [Skeleton](https://cadence.dev/r/skeleton.md): A placeholder pulse that marks where content will land. (feedback, data)
- [Alert](https://cadence.dev/r/alert.md): A message about the current state of the page, with an icon column and an action slot. (feedback)
- [Empty](https://cadence.dev/r/empty.md): The resting state of a region that has nothing to show yet. (feedback, layout)
- [Item](https://cadence.dev/r/item.md): A row in a list of like objects, with media, content, and actions. (data, layout)
- [Field](https://cadence.dev/r/field.md): A labelled control with its description and error, without owning validation. (form)
- [Button Group](https://cadence.dev/r/button-group.md): Adjacent controls joined into one shape. (form, layout)
- [Input Group](https://cadence.dev/r/input-group.md): A text control framed with prefixes, suffixes, and buttons. (form)
- [Breadcrumb](https://cadence.dev/r/breadcrumb.md): The trail from the root to the current page. (navigation)
- [Pagination](https://cadence.dev/r/pagination.md): Page navigation that stays a link, not a button. (navigation)
- [Spinner](https://cadence.dev/r/spinner.md): An indeterminate wait, rotating until the work finishes. (feedback)
- [Dialog](https://cadence.dev/r/dialog.md): A modal window that fades and settles in, with the open and close sequence interruptible. (overlay)
- [Checkbox](https://cadence.dev/r/checkbox.md): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked. (form)
- [Radio Group](https://cadence.dev/r/radio-group.md): A set of checkable buttons where no more than one can be checked at a time. (form)
- [Switch](https://cadence.dev/r/switch.md): A control that toggles between on and off, with a thumb that travels between the two states. (form)
- [Slider](https://cadence.dev/r/slider.md): An input where the user selects a value from a range by dragging a thumb. (form)
- [Toggle](https://cadence.dev/r/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be pressed or not pressed. (form)
- [Toggle Group](https://cadence.dev/r/toggle-group.md): A set of two-state buttons that can be pressed one at a time or together. (form)
- [Input OTP](https://cadence.dev/r/input-otp.md): A one-time password field that renders one slot per character. (form)
- [Progress](https://cadence.dev/r/progress.md): Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task. (feedback)
- [Alert Dialog](https://cadence.dev/r/alert-dialog.md): A modal confirmation that interrupts the flow and needs an explicit choice before anything happens. (overlay)
- [Popover](https://cadence.dev/r/popover.md): An anchored panel that opens next to its trigger and returns focus to it when it closes. (overlay)
- [Tooltip](https://cadence.dev/r/tooltip.md): A short label that names a control on hover or focus, and disappears when the pointer leaves. (overlay)
- [Hover Card](https://cadence.dev/r/hover-card.md): A preview panel that opens from a link on hover or focus and disappears when the pointer leaves. (overlay)
- [Sheet](https://cadence.dev/r/sheet.md): A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen and holds a focused task without leaving the page. (overlay)
- [Drawer](https://cadence.dev/r/drawer.md): A bottom sheet that opens over the page, follows a drag, and closes on swipe or on request. (overlay)
- [Select](https://cadence.dev/r/select.md): A control that opens a list of options and keeps the chosen value in the trigger. (form)

## Docs

- [Installation](https://cadence.dev/docs/installation): registry setup, Next.js and Vite.
- [Theming](https://cadence.dev/docs/theming): shadcn tokens, motion intensity, per-subtree overrides.
- [Motion](https://cadence.dev/docs/motion): tokens, recipes, reduced-motion rules.
- [Validation](https://cadence.dev/docs/validation): what the components render and what the caller owns.
- [Install index](https://cadence.dev/r/registry.json): every item and its metadata.
- [Catalog](https://cadence.dev/r/catalog.json): machine-readable catalog.
- [Full context](https://cadence.dev/llms-full.txt): every component doc inline.
